note: M3.0 D7 freeze scaffold. Parameters are transcribed verbatim from docs/m3-design.md rev1 sections 2.2/3.2/3.3 as v0; D4 (ghost-closure validity on REAL canvases, a P0->P2 boundary activity) SETS the patience parameters from its measured table and REPINS this file (new version + new sha, both recorded in the report). The embedded sha256 is the canonical digest of this object WITHOUT the sha256 field; load_verdict_config() re-derives it and refuses a tampered file.
informed_class_provenance: docs/m3-design.md rev1 section 3.2: 'filtering to E0xxx classes: E0277/E0282/E0283/E0507/E0382-style substantive diagnostics, and requiring the error to persist/point inside committed content away from hole-adjacent spans'. E0308/E0499/E0061/E0599/E0369/E0502/E0505 are the same substantive class family (type/borrow/arity/method-resolution, all non-parse); adopted in v0 because they are the diagnostics the corrected-basis forensic rows actually produced.

patience.provenance: docs/m3-design.md rev1 section 3.3 item 1: 'informed-class rustc errors whose primary span sits inside committed (non-ghost) content, stable across >=2 consecutive checkpoints OR at a stage the rung has measured reliable (D4 decides the actual rule; start: 2-checkpoint persistence + span-localization)' || REPINNED v1 by D4 measurement (see d4_repin): 3 consecutive checkpoints, since measured mid-canvas recall is 0 until the final step so the tighter patience costs no true-kill latency.

r0.provenance: docs/m3-design.md rev1 section 3.2 R0 row: fence integrity, prose-after-closing-fence (HumanEval_17 class), mask-residue sanity (expected residual mask share at step k ~ (1-k/S) +- tolerance), must_define fn-header presence late in decode, brace trajectory. extract_rejected_final is recorded but NOT fatal: at the final checkpoint the game still emits a canvas (design section 3.3 item 2) and its failure is scored honestly.

findings.note_final: at the FINAL checkpoint the any-error screen detected 5/5 compile-dead (HumanEval_0 4/4 E0277; HumanEval_4 1/4)
findings.false_kill_on_live_canvases: 0/12 observations (HumanEval_11, 3 live particles x 4 checkpoints); 0/0 on the unreachable pair because all 8 finals were dead (no live side to measure)
findings.sim_comparison: design 3.2 sim predicted informed recall 0-1/36 at <=85% committed; measured 0/5 at <=75% - the sim's low-recall curve REPLICATES on real canvases, so the confidence-ranked commit order did NOT buy the recall the design hoped for

d4_repin.decision: D4 demotion rule (design 7 D4): live mid-decode informed-class yield tracks the sim's low-recall curve, so the kill/clone cells demote in the documented order. patience_checkpoints raised 2->3 (the only parameter change: with per-checkpoint recall measured at 0 until the final step, requiring 3 consecutive checkpoints costs nothing in true-kill latency and tightens the false-kill guard further). hole_proximity_lines stays 1: 0 false kills measured at that setting. C-kill is DROPPED first if a budget cut is needed; C-full's mid-decode rungs reduce in checkpoint density first. The honest summary for any C-full result demotes to 'ladder + final screen' unless C-full - C-screen >= +2.

rev2.basis: P1 probe commit 7c8a124: T=0.4 produced 0 passing canvases of 36; the reachable band starts at T>=0.8. rev1 ladder {0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8} spends half its canvases in the measured dead zone.

diversity_ladder.structural_role: emission-preferred base canvas; protects the 11-passer cohort (M2.4b banked at T=0.2)

rev2.kill_clone_reason: D4 demotion rule executed: mid-canvas informed-class recall measured 0/5 at <=75% committed; no kill window exists at the frozen grid. C-kill cell DROPPED; C-full mid-decode rungs demoted to late-window-only verdicts; honest C-full summary demotes to 'ladder + final screen' unless C-full - C-screen >= +2.

clone.note: supersedes v1 clone {temp_step:0.2, cap:0.8}: children of a 0.2 parent would start at 0.4 = measured dead zone. Clone machinery itself is OFF under kill_clone_enabled=false; this block is retained so a future re-enable inherits the re-based band, not the dead one.
